tactics:
induction p with
  | nil => simp [Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.isNonZero] at h
  | cons kv p ih => rcases kv with ⟨k, v⟩; by_cases hv : v = Nat.Internal.Linear.fixedVar <;> simp_all [Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.isNonZero, Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.denote, Nat.Internal.Linear.Var.denote] <;> omega
induction p <;> simp_all [Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.isNonZero, Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.denote, Nat.Internal.Linear.Var.denote] <;> omega
